body: Hello, I would like to work on this bug. Am I able to start working on this? What is required?

Just go on and submit a PR. [Here's the guide](https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md#committing-code).

If you have anything to ask, feel free to do it.

issue.title: fix: Implement { log: false } for clearLocalStorage Issue #6342

repository.name: cypress
repository.description: Fast, easy and reliable testing for anything that runs in a browser.

issue.body:
- Closes #6342 

### User facing changelog
 add `options` in `clearLocalStorage` for disabling log - https://docs.cypress.io/api/commands/clearlocalstorage.html#Arguments

### Additional details
It's a bugfix enabling the `log` options for `clearLocalStorage` command
